expectations.text: The response derives weights or requirements from Brindlewick's own needs rather than generic ones
expectations.evidence: Each weight is tied to Brindlewick's context: versioning at 25 because 'Engine and SDK releases (Unity, Unreal, Godot) force readers onto old versions', i18n because 'Studios are international (Korea, Japan, China, EU)', AI search because of '220 pages', and SSO 'only if you gate docs for enterprise or NDA'd studio customers'. The tie-break steps also fit the team ('C#/C++ code highlighting', 'import from your current docs').
